interpretation.headline: Evaluation is COMPLETE. Phase H is NOT promoted.

concerns.detail: Lowest quality metric by a wide margin (36.33 points below the next-worst metric, transaction_type at 80.86%). Grounding is a fail-closed gate in the production path, so this is the blocking concern for any promotion decision.

A ~11 point gap between 'parses as JSON' and 'carries exactly the 18 contract fields' means roughly 1 in 8 otherwise-valid outputs is missing or has extra fields. The production schema verifier would reject these.

concerns.concern: Exactly 1 accounting-leakage case must be investigated
concerns.detail: Leakage-free is otherwise 99.91% (1143/1144). A single leak is still a real, must-understand occurrence and is treated as a required investigation item, not a rounding error.

acceptable_for_now: Performance is usable at ~1.94 s/example on a T4 (P95 1.98 s, throughput 0.5142 ex/s).
Parties (92.31%), amounts (88.90%) and payment_method (90.03%) are comparatively strong.
explicit_non_conclusions: DO NOT treat the old Phase 6C / FYJC-focused Hugging Face Space as the Phase H production artifact.
DO NOT interpret Phase H as evidence that Platrixa is FYJC-only; Phase H was explicitly trained broader.
DO NOT read a 0.00065822 final eval loss as a quality signal; the 62.67% grounding result contradicts any inference that the model is production-ready.
interpretation.next_step: Failure analysis of the grounding failures and the single accounting-leakage case, followed by the Phase 24 breadth/generalization evaluation.
